title: Earth observation: default event set
assumptions: Two declared scenario events (a wildfire tasking request during science and a ground-station outage during the contact period) occur on days drawn from independent seeded scenario streams; they are the only random element of the run.
The scenario events are illustrative narrative, not real tasking or station schedules.

scenarioEvents.title: Wildfire tasking request
scenarioEvents.situation: Emergency services ask the mission to image an active wildfire, which displaces part of the planned science timeline.
scenarioEvents.prompt: Accept the tasking or keep the science plan?
scenarioEvents.counterfactual: Plan science with slack so a tasking request can be accepted without losing a required measurement.

choices.label: Keep the science plan
choices.tradeoff: The planned science is unchanged; the wildfire imagery (not scored) is not taken.

choices.label: Accept the tasking
choices.tradeoff: Public-service imagery (not scored), but the fire imaging takes half of the instrument time of every later planned observation.

scenarioEvents.title: Ground-station outage
scenarioEvents.situation: The primary ground station goes offline for maintenance.
scenarioEvents.prompt: Wait for the primary station or reroute to a smaller backup station?
scenarioEvents.counterfactual: Plan contacts with more than one station or enough slack to absorb an outage.

choices.label: Wait for the primary station
choices.tradeoff: Full-rate contacts resume after the outage, but contacts in the next 3 days are missed.

choices.label: Reroute to the backup station
choices.tradeoff: No contacts missed, but the smaller backup antenna halves the downlink rate for the rest of the mission.
